{{short description|German mathematician}}
[[File:Anna Wienhard MFO.jpg|thumb|Wienhard at [[Mathematical Research Institute of Oberwolfach|Oberwolfach]], 2010]]
'''Anna Katharina Wienhard''' (born 1977)<ref name="erc">[http://www.uni-protokolle.de/nachrichten/id/272545/ European Research Council Funds Heidelberg Mathematician], Press Release, Ruprecht-Karls-Universität Heidelberg, February 5, 2014, retrieved 2015-01-18.</ref> is a German [[mathematician]] whose research concerns [[differential geometry]], and especially the use of higher [[Teichmüller space]]s to study the [[deformation theory]] of [[symmetry|symmetric]] geometric structures.<ref name="erc"/> She is a director at the [[Max Planck Institute for Mathematics in the Sciences]].<ref name="mpi">[https://www.mpg.de/19381685/mathematics-in-the-sciences-wienhard Anna Wienhard], Scientific Members, Max-Planck-Gesellschaft, retrieved 2023-09-09</ref>

==Education and career==
Wienhard did her undergraduate studies at the [[University of Bonn]], earning a double degree in [[theology]] and mathematics.<ref name="erc"/> Continuing at Bonn, she earned a doctorate in 2004 under the joint supervision of [[Hans Werner Ballmann]] and Marc Burger.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=98035}}</ref>

After holding temporary positions at the [[University of Basel]], [[Institute for Advanced Study]], and [[University of Chicago]], she took a faculty position at [[Princeton University]] in 2007. She moved to Heidelberg as a full professor in 2012<ref name="cv">[http://www.mathi.uni-heidelberg.de/~wienhard/ Curriculum vitae], retrieved 2015-01-18.</ref> and to Leipzig as a research director at the [[Max Planck Institute for Mathematics in the Sciences]]<ref name="mpi"/> in 2022.

==Recognition==
From 2009 to 2013, Wienhard was a member of the Young Academy of the [[German Academy of Sciences Leopoldina]] and [[Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences and Humanities]].<ref name="cv"/> In 2012, she became one of the inaugural [[fellow]]s of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2015-01-18.</ref> She was elected as a regular member of the Leopoldina in 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.leopoldina.org/mitgliederverzeichnis/mitglieder/member/Member/show/anna-wienhard/|title=Anna Wienhard|work=Members|publisher=Leopoldina|access-date=2023-05-17}}</ref>

She was the [[Emmy Noether]] Lecturer of the [[German Mathematical Society]] in 2012,<ref>{{citation|url=https://www.mathematik.de/dmv/preise-auszeichnungen|title=Preise und Auszeichnungen|publisher=[[German Mathematical Society]]|language=German|accessdate=2018-11-05}}</ref> and an invited speaker at the 2018 [[International Congress of Mathematicians]].<ref name=icm>{{citation|url=http://www.icm2018.org/portal/en/invited-section-lectures-speakers|title=Invited section lectures|work=ICM 2018|accessdate=2018-08-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171025163517/http://www.icm2018.org/portal/en/invited-section-lectures-speakers|archive-date=2017-10-25|url-status=dead}}</ref> She was named [[Mathematical Sciences Research Institute|MSRI]] Clay Senior Scholar for Fall 2019.<ref>{{Cite web|last=MSRI|title=Mathematical Sciences Research Institute|url=http://www.msri.org/|access-date=2021-06-07|website=www.msri.org}}</ref>
